message: No detected input validation: The code uses only basic `assert type(set) == str` checks in msdi.py and no schema, dtype, shape, or value-range validation is performed on the loaded data arrays.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local file paths (CSV, .npy, .npz files) with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication anywhere in the code.

No detected label flipping detection: Labels are encoded with LabelEncoder and converted to one-hot via to_categorical, but no distribution comparison, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tool is applied.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code loads and saves features without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code calls model.load_model(MODEL_DIR) inside a bare try/except but performs no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading the serialized model.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training; labels are simply encoded and fed to the model.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, neural-cleanse-style trigger scanning, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or applied anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial attack/robustness testing anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test split is loaded, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement preventing test data leakage into training, and no multiple independent metric sources; the bare-minimum split alone does not constitute metric tampering protection.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on data loaded from files before passing it to the model; data is loaded and passed directly without sanitization.

No detected output bounds checks: The code calls model.evaluate() and model.classification_report() but there is no check on output probabilities, NaN guards, or threshold validation before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a multimodal classification pipeline (audio, image, text, MFCC), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
